title: Phase 8 / E13: External / Source-Disjoint Task Validation Protocol
primary_question: Does the GRWC exact-disclosure admission kernel generalize without schema modifications to externally authored clinical datasets (eICU, MIMIC-IV) and disjoint assertion tasks?
unit_of_analysis: One externally authored clinical scenario evaluated against the GLHS admission kernel.

primary_endpoints.name: External Task Reconstruction Completeness
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of external tasks successfully canonicalized into THSS snapshots without information loss.

secondary_endpoints.name: Cross-Site Governance Pass Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of external patient timelines passing GRWC invariant checks.

sample_size.unit_definition: 200 external clinical timeline tasks across 4 independent corpora (eICU, Synthea, MIMIC-IV, Diabetes)

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Synthetic multi-agent reviewer panels are explicitly forbidden from being cited as human validation.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Inaccessible external records are recorded as UNABLE_TO_VERIFY.
